_meta.title: Jewish losses in the Holocaust, by country (USHMM estimates)
_meta.measures: Estimated number of Jewish people killed in the Holocaust, by prewar country and wartime region, with the prewar Jewish population, as the Museum gives them. Figures are estimates; ranges are kept as published. 'value' = the upper figure of the published range (for colouring only); read 'deaths_as_published' for the exact wording.
_meta.source: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Holocaust Encyclopedia
_meta.licence: USHMM Terms of Use: visitors may use the site 'for personal, educational, research, and other purposes'; cite 'United States Holocaust Memorial Museum' (no abbreviation) and link to the page. https://www.ushmm.org/information/about-the-museum/terms-of-use
_meta.citation: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, 'Jewish Losses during the Holocaust: By Country', Holocaust Encyclopedia (last edited 27 March 2018).
_meta.notes: Country records use prewar states that match a present-day country one-to-one. Wartime units that do not (Czechoslovakia, Soviet Union, Yugoslavia, occupied/annexed regions) are kept whole under _historical_units with present_day_iso3_if_single where one present-day country contains the region; a map can draw these as labels or historic outlines. Sub-regions (e.g. Bohemia-Moravia, Slovakia) are parts of their parent units: do not add them to the parent figure. Total given elsewhere by USHMM: six million.
